video.title: Target, Scheme & Build Configuration | Day 231
video.description:
Learn to explain how an Xcode project is organized into products and builds: Target, Scheme & Build Configuration, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Target - A set of files and settings that Xcode builds into one product, such as an app or a widget.
Scheme - A saved recipe that tells Xcode what to build and which configuration to use when you run.
Build Configuration - A named group of build settings, such as Debug or Release, that Xcode uses to compile your code.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Target, Scheme & Build Configuration | Day 231
landscape.description:
Explain Target, Scheme & Build Configuration in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Target, Scheme, Build Configuration 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Target - A set of files and settings that Xcode builds into one product, such as an app or a widget.
한국어: Target: 앱이나 위젯 같은 하나의 결과물로 빌드되는 파일과 설정의 묶음

Scheme - A saved recipe that tells Xcode what to build and which configuration to use when you run.
한국어: Scheme: 실행할 때 무엇을 빌드하고 어떤 구성을 쓸지 Xcode에 알려 주는 저장된 설정

Build Configuration - A named group of build settings, such as Debug or Release, that Xcode uses to compile your code.
한국어: Build Configuration: Debug나 Release처럼 Xcode가 코드를 컴파일할 때 쓰는 빌드 설정 묶음

In this video, Mina and Jake talk about how Xcode targets, schemes and build configurations fit together, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Target, Scheme and Build Configuration in English?

dialogue.title: One app, many builds
dialogue.setting: Adding a widget to the project

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I need a widget for our app. Where do I start in Xcode?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a new target. A target is a set of files and settings that builds one product.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the app and the widget are two different targets?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Each target has its own files, settings and bundle.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I choose which one to run?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a scheme. A scheme tells Xcode what to build and which configuration to use.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I pick the scheme from the menu at the top?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Pick the App scheme and press run.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Why does `name` show App Dev on my phone, but App in the store build?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is the build configuration. Debug and Release are two build configurations.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the Debug build configuration sets the `DEBUG` flag?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and the scheme picks that build configuration when you run.

dialogue.code:
#if DEBUG
let name = "App Dev"
#else
let name = "App"
#endif
print(name)
